Description: Guidance law shall compute a_cmd equals N times Vc times omega_LOS
Line-of-sight angular rate shall be computed as cross product of r and r_dot divided by magnitude of r squared
Closing velocity shall be computed as negative rate of change of target-missile range
Navigation constant N shall be a configurable model parameter with default value 4
Commanded lateral acceleration magnitude shall be saturated to LATAX_MAX
LATAX_MAX shall be a configurable model parameter in metres per second squared
Saturation shall preserve the direction of the commanded acceleration vector
Missile velocity shall be updated by integrating saturated commanded acceleration
Missile position shall be updated by integrating missile velocity
Initial missile velocity magnitude V_M0 shall be a configurable model parameter
Intercept shall be declared when target-missile range falls below R_LETHAL
Timeout shall be declared when simulation time exceeds T_MAX
LOS reversal termination shall be declared when closing velocity becomes negative after peak
Root inport r_T shall accept target position in metres inertial frame
Root inport v_T shall accept target velocity in metres per second inertial frame
Root inport t shall accept elapsed engagement time in seconds
Root outport r_M_out shall expose missile position in metres inertial frame
Root outport v_M_out shall expose missile velocity in metres per second inertial frame
Root outport term_flag_out shall expose termination state 0 in-flight 1 intercept 2 timeout 3 LOS reversal
